fact.claim: In the feature availability by resource table, Amazon Aurora has check marks for cross-Region backup, cross-account backup, AWS Backup Audit Manager, incremental backup, continuous backup and point-in-time restore, restore testing and logically air-gapped vault, and no check mark for full management, lifecycle to cold storage, item-level restore, backup search, backup tiering, malware protection or access points. The incremental backup check carries footnote 6: snapshots are full and incremental backup is offered through PITR. The cross-Region and cross-account checks carry footnote 3: Amazon RDS, Aurora, DocumentDB, and Neptune support cross-Region and cross-account snapshot copying in a single action.
fact.question: Which AWS Backup features does Amazon Aurora support, including continuous backup and cold storage?
